question: On untouched FINAL_TEST and OOD rows, does the exact L8H3+H7 cached final-number payload causally transfer the model's final-label-plus-one rule while preserving true copy controls?

semantic_correction.reason: R567 registered this family as last visible label plus one against arithmetic continuation, and R572 independently confirmed that behavior on FIT and SELECT before v4.

split_policy.rows: Every row in each declared family and split; deterministic complete adjacent-final-number pairing frozen by the model-free authority compiler before execution.

intervention.operation: Replace the donor cached-value factor only in the exact final-source H3+H7 summand; retain native attention scores and native current-value terms.

bars.exact_replay_and_factor_tolerances: Same 1e-10 replay/decomposition and 1e-5 installed-term bars as v2-v4.

frozen_outcomes.cached_successor_payload_selective_ood: Both held-out splits pass every positive transfer and negative copy-control bar.
frozen_outcomes.cached_payload_not_selective: Positive transfer passes but at least one capable negative copy-control bar fails.
frozen_outcomes.no_held_out_successor_transfer: Instrument and native capability pass, but positive transfer fails.
frozen_outcomes.invalid: Any native capability, authority hash, liveness, or exactness gate fails.

claim_scope: This can identify a fixed H3+H7 cached successor payload across list/digit/step-two constructions when combined with the already frozen cross-format target leg. It does not identify either head alone or a globally shared numeral variable.
anti_rank_gate: No rank, reconstruction, variance, quantization, or fitted basis is computed.
